correctness.rationale: The nondegenerate third-coordinate two-step linear system yields unique z,w. A verified polynomial factorization splits all solutions into a=b (fixed), a=-b (one antipodal prime-two orbit for nu_2>-(1-nu_1)), and ab=-(1-nu_1)(1+nu_3) (a quadratic in a²,b²). Its discriminant gives exactly two genuinely additional, distinct reflected cycles only for nu_2>2(1-nu_1)nu_3/(1-nu_3); equality merges into the first. All signs and strict endpoints are checked, as are exact iteration identities and the nu_3=1/3 threshold order. Reproducible exact SymPy tests include two distinct rational witnesses; the all-real exhaustiveness follows algebraically, not from finite tests.

value.rationale: Complete prime-two orbit count in an established 3D axial-symmetric diffeomorphism is a natural global dynamical invariant, distinct from local period-doubling and attractor pictures. The sharp second branch has an exact symmetry-breaking amplitude and a codimension-two ordering reversal at nu_3=1/3; in an open region all three two-cycles coexist with the unique origin fixed point. This reveals structural information that cannot be inferred from existing source local bifurcations or isolated numerical sightings.
